evidence_quote: Force-regulated robotic DRS enables standardized, autonomous tissue scanning with expert-level spectral consistency, advancing spectroscopic sensing toward reliable automated surgical margin assessment.
rationale: The system supports surgical margin assessment relevant to cancer resection. Its relevance is methodological: validation uses bovine and ovine tissues without reported tumor-specific testing, biomarkers, or tumor biology.
ambiguity_note: The boundary is whether technology intended to support tumor resection, evaluated without reported malignant tissue testing, falls within experimental cancer treatments or adjacent surgical instrumentation.
